observations.leafGeometry: One broad leaf has a dark green large upper-facing surface and a curled pale right-hand strip continuous with the same leaf; it reads as an exposed underside rather than two unrelated leaf halves.
observations.stomatalStructure: The magnified epidermal view shows two bean-shaped green guard cells, green oval organelle markers and a dark pore between them; surrounding pavement cells are pale and have no same green organelle markers.
observations.connectorAndArrows: White zoom connector originates in the pale underside strip. The gray CO2 arrow terminates in that underside region. Yellow sunlight arrow is directed at the dark upper surface. Root-side water uptake and generic exchange arrows provide a coherent plant context.
observations.360px: Energie, Struktur, Austausch and CO2 remain legible, with distinct source arrow and curled underside. The smaller Blattunterseite caption and chloroplast dots are secondary detail; core interpretation does not require reading that caption.
observations.680px: All main concepts and the underside caption are legible. Guard-cell pair, pore and epidermal background are distinct.
observations.scope: Illustrative typical broadleaf example, not a universal claim that all species have stomata only on the lower surface.
